scope: Two complete affected test suites after original macOS CI failure; prior full local product acceptance retained. This is not a new full clean build or final three-platform CI receipt.
conditionalCaseCountExplanation: JUnit disables the POSIX parameterized template on Windows before creating its three invocations, so Windows records one skipped template plus one skipped directory-access test. macOS/Linux create all three symbolic-alias cases plus the directory-access test.
